name: MACD Stochastic
summary: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries, requiring both indicators to confirm momentum direction before opening positions. It uses MACD for trend/momentum direction and Stochastic for overbought/oversold timing, creating a dual-confirmation trading system. The EA opens buy trades when MACD is bullish and Stochastic is oversold, and sell trades when MACD is bearish and Stochastic is overbought.
summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和随机振荡器信号来产生交易入场信号，要求两个指标同时确认动量方向后才开仓。它使用MACD判断趋势/动量方向，使用随机指标判断超买超卖时机，构成双重确认交易系统。当MACD看涨且随机指标超卖时开多单，当MACD看跌且随机指标超买时开空单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用MACD与Stochastic双指标动量确认策略，核心概念是利用MACD判断中期趋势方向，同时利用Stochastic振荡器在超买超卖区域寻找入场时机。入场条件为：做多时要求MACD主线在信号线上方（或MACD柱状图为正）且Stochastic从超卖区上穿；做空时要求MACD主线在信号线下方（或MACD柱状图为负）且Stochastic从超买区下穿。出场条件可能包含固定止盈止损或指标反转信号出场。仓位管理方面，EA通常提供手数参数供用户设置，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA依赖固定手数或简单比例仓位，缺乏高级资金管理机制如凯利公式或风险比例仓位控制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但双指标确认可能导致入场信号偏少，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-indicator momentum confirmation strategy combining MACD and Stochastic oscillator, where the core concept uses MACD to identify medium-term trend direction and Stochastic to find entry timing in overbought/oversold zones. Entry conditions require: for buy signals, MACD main line above signal line (or positive histogram) combined with Stochastic crossing up from oversold territory; for sell signals, MACD main line below signal line (or negative histogram) combined with Stochastic crossing down from overbought territory. Exit conditions may include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or indicator reversal-based exits. Position sizing typically relies on a user-configured lot size parameter, with some versions potentially including simple account-balance-based dynamic lot calculation. Money management is relatively basic, depending on fixed lot sizes or simple proportional sizing without advanced mechanisms like Kelly criterion or risk-percentage position control. The overall strategy logic is clear, but dual-indicator confirmation may result in fewer entry signals, and the system can generate frequent false signals in choppy, range-bound markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop

pros: 双指标确认机制降低虚假信号，提高入场质量
MACD与Stochastic互补，一个判趋势一个判时机，逻辑合理
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期优化指标参数
策略逻辑简单直观，便于理解和回测验证
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
MACD and Stochastic complement each other well — one identifies trend, the other identifies timing
Highly configurable parameters allow users to optimize indicator settings for different instruments and timeframes
Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, making it easy to understand and backtest
cons: 双指标确认可能导致入场信号稀少，错过部分行情
在震荡市中MACD容易频繁翻转产生虚假趋势判断
缺乏高级资金管理机制，固定手数无法适应不同风险环境
Stochastic在强趋势市中可能长期停留在超买超卖区导致信号滞后
cons_en: Dual-indicator confirmation may result in scarce entry signals, missing some market opportunities
MACD can frequently flip in choppy markets, generating false trend judgments
Lacks advanced money management — fixed lot sizing cannot adapt to varying risk environments
Stochastic may stay in overbought/oversold zones for extended periods during strong trends, causing delayed signals
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更大周期均线）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe moving average) to reduce false signals in choppy markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot sizes
Add spread filtering and session control to avoid trading during high-cost and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 止损参数默认为0，若用户未设置则持仓无保护，面临无限亏损风险
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能不利入场
未明确包含新K线检查逻辑，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Stop-loss parameter defaults to 0 — if not set by user, positions have no protection and face unlimited loss risk
No spread filter mechanism — entries may occur under unfavorable high-spread conditions
No explicit new bar check logic — may open multiple positions within the same bar
